Two standalone checkers replayed exact small-n spectra and weighted traces.

value.rationale: A locally stable configuration of anti-coordinating agents is a one-flip maximal graph cut; the quality gap from the global optimum and its distribution are natural dynamical performance invariants. The full energy landscape shows the exact n=6 or n>=8 onset of strictly suboptimal equilibria and an explicit Gaussian law giving typical cut ratio about 1.4115/1.5, while the chance of optimality decays exponentially. This physical/dynamical statement requires additional objective mapping and analytic spectral work beyond the classical total Perrin number. The claim is finite-graph exact plus a proved infinite-family limit.
